response.summary: Results: 3 accepted (F2, F3, F5) and 2 modified (F1, F4). The owner should check F1 first. The sketch still does not prevent a duplicate task when a crash comes between the send and store.save. The new note explains the gap and says closing it needs server-side deduplication agreed with the vendor; the sketch does not assume one. F2 and F3 rely on the reviewer's cited A2A v1.0 pages (TASK_STATE_*, ROLE_*, Part, returnImmediately default false); I could not open them here. Tests: 27 passed. Two extra commands were blocked by permission: a sed edit (done with Edit instead) and a combined awk / standalone link-checker run.

responses.reason: Real gap: the checkpoint only covers crashes after store.save. A full one-task guarantee would need a server dedup contract that the sources do not specify, so I did not code one. Instead I added a dated note: the sent-but-not-recorded case from 3.5, and the fix needs a stable request identity the server deduplicates on, or reconciliation, agreed with the vendor. I also qualified the Layer 4 bullet and added a Try-it step to kill the process between the send and the save.
